author: @wariobot09

evidence.api_compatibility: Breaking change in API response encoding: ModelInfo::registry_source changed default from 'huggingface' to empty string. Two JSON endpoints (GET /pull/variants and GET /model/:id) serialize registry_source through remote_registry_source_name(parse_remote_registry_source(...)), which means an empty registry_source produces an empty string in the JSON response instead of 'huggingface'. This is a subtle but real API change — any client parsing the source field assuming it is always 'huggingface' or 'modelscope' will see '' and may misinterpret it. The commit does note FLM models don't persist provenance, but this affects the /models API for all models. This change was not flagged by the author as a breaking change.
evidence.documentation: Documentation is updated: docs/dev/model-registries.md clarifies FLM does not persist per-model registry provenance; docs/guide/configuration/README.md documents FLM's relationship to default_model_source; docs/dev/backends-reference.md and docs/guide/cli.md have the flm.modelscope row removed (since ModelScope is now selected via the existing mechanism). The documentation accurately reflects the code changes.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The feature is user-reachable: 'lemonade pull <model> --source modelscope' or 'default_model_source: modelscope' config change. No human ran the actual model download from ModelScope or verified end-to-end behavior. Two API surfaces changed: (1) registry_source in /models and /pull/variants responses is now empty-string instead of 'huggingface' for models without an explicit source — clients that assume registry_source is always 'huggingface' may break; (2) the effective precedence changed from 'empty means huggingface always' to 'explicit per-model source always wins'. These are in the release surface and should be manually verified.
evidence.post_approval_commits: The first approval was from @superm1 on 2026-07-29 at commit 6b4caf5. Two commits were added after that approval: (a) 'fix(flm): preserve explicit pull source' (2b47236) which ensures explicit --source on an FLM pull reaches the download path, and (b) 'refactor(flm): clarify model source resolution' (bcfc5c9) which renamed effective_model_source to download_source_for, fixed the empty-vs-explicit precedence bug, and changed registry_source default from 'huggingface' to empty string. Neither commit introduces new behavioral surface; (a) fixes a regression and (b) addresses reviewer concerns raised by @SlawomirNowaczyk. @ZaneNi's final approval on bcfc5c9 covers both post-approval commits.
evidence.review: PR #2841 received an initial APPROVED from @superm1 (2026-07-29, on commit 6b4caf5, the first commit). @ZaneNi tested on Windows, found that --modelscope was not reaching flm pull, filed CHANGES_REQUESTED (2026-09-02), and later re-APPROVED (2026-09-02, on final commit bcfc5c9). The review was subject-matter appropriate: @superm1 is listed as an admin maintainer with subject area in FastFlowLM. Two substantive improvement suggestions from @SlawomirNowaczyk were noted but did not block merge: (1) an asymmetric precedence bug in the original effective_model_source implementation where explicit per-model HuggingFace could be silently overridden by a modelscope server default, and (2) a naming collision between effective_model_source and effective_registry_source. Both were addressed in the refactor commit (bcfc5c9), which renamed the method to download_source_for() and fixed the precedence by checking !info.registry_source.empty() first. @jeremyfowers was requested as reviewer but their review was DISMISSED; their earlier PR-review bot flags about the PR description were noted.
evidence.security: No security concerns identified. The change adds a --modelscope 1 CLI flag to the flm download path. No credential handling, no new network protocols, no code execution surface changes. Supply-chain risk is minimal: the dependency is on the FLM backend's --modelscope flag and model.download() calls which already existed.
evidence.tests: 47 new lines in test/cpp/test_config_default_source.cpp covering: (1) unpinned download falls back to HuggingFace without provider, (2) unpinned FLM download follows configured default, (3) explicit HuggingFace overrides default, (4) explicit ModelScope overrides default, (5) flm_pull_arguments emits --modelscope 1 for ModelScope and omits it for HuggingFace, and (6) checkpoint-less refresh preserves explicit source. CI passed on all major check suites (C++ Server Build/Test/Release, CodeQL, Container Build Tests, Docker Smoke Test, backend-docs-drift, pre-commit). No end-to-end FLM download test is present; only unit tests.

Set default_model_source=modelscope in the server config, then run lemonade pull qwen3-0.6b-FLM without --source and confirm it downloads from ModelScope (not HuggingFace).

shout_outs.reason: Performed hands-on Windows testing that caught a bug where --modelscope was not reaching the flm pull command, driving a fix before merge.

subject: feat(flm): resolve FLM model source from default_model_source (#2841)
summary: Makes the FLM backend resolve its download source from the server-wide default_model_source config (and per-model source/registry_source overrides) instead of a separate flm.modelscope recipe toggle, passing --modelscope 1 to the flm CLI when ModelScope is selected.
verdict_reason: No evidence that anyone exercised the FLM ModelScope download path end-to-end, and the PR changes how the /models and /pull/variants API endpoints encode registry_source (now requires non-empty registry_source for a value), which callers may depend on.
